infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: DiabEats uses your camera to scan restaurant menus and packaged-food barcodes or QR codes, helping you review public label information and diabetes-conscious food patterns.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: DiabEats allows you to upload menu or packaged-food label photos from your library for educational food insights.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: DiabEats uses your location to show nearby diabetes-friendly restaurants and safe meal options.
infoPlist.NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription: DiabEats can send you daily reminders to check safe meal options before dining out.
